text.name: Primakov's U-turn
text.rules: Record "turn over the Atlantic". Until the end of this turn, points spent by LIO count 1 less, never below 1.
text.history: On 24 March 1999 Russian prime minister Yevgeny Primakov, flying to Washington, ordered his plane to turn back over the Atlantic when told that NATO's bombing of Yugoslavia was about to begin.
